document.name: Union Square Play Open Play - Upper East Side
document.shortDescription: Union Square Play lists weekday open-play sessions for babies, toddlers, and preschool-age kids at its Upper East Side studio on East 84th Street.
document.longDescription:
Union Square Play's official Upper East Side page describes the E 84th Street location as a neighborhood hub for early childhood development and says the studio offers classes and open play. The location page lists Union Square Play at 245 E 84th Street, New York, NY 10028, with contact points info@unionsquareplay.com and (917) 397-2843.

The official classes page frames the studio's programming around early-childhood play and development. On the official Spring 2026 UES schedule PDF, Union Square Play publishes an Open Play session on Mondays at 2:00 PM for ages 0-5 years and another Open Play session on Fridays at 9:30 AM for ages 6 months-3 years. Those source-backed recurring slots support Weekday, Morning, and Afternoon tags for this listing.

The same official Upper East Side page also states Monday-Friday hours of 9:00am-5:00pm for classes and open play. Union Square Play's official site links out to a Sawyer booking page dedicated to this location's drop-ins.

Sources: https://www.unionsquareplay.com/upper-east-side https://www.unionsquareplay.com/classes-programs https://www.unionsquareplay.com/_files/ugd/134920_9559eb9a0b0c42bba061dba466c0576c.pdf https://www.hisawyer.com/union-square-play-1/schedules?location_id%5B%5D=134001&schedule_id=drop-ins https://static.wixstatic.com/media/134920_2c4e000746d84e049fb5377ab6412457%7Emv2.jpg/v1/fit/w_2500,h_1330,al_c/134920_2c4e000746d84e049fb5377ab6412457%7Emv2.jpg
